name: smoove
title: smoove
description: Skills for making videos with smoove, a timeline-driven animation engine built on top of Konva.

skills.name: smoove-video
skills.description: Write and change smoove videos: plan the beats, build scenes and clips, lay out with Flex and Block, animate with interpolate, add text, fonts and media, and check the result in the studio without rendering.

skills.name: smoove-best-practices
skills.description: Run, embed, and render a smoove composition: wiring <smoove-player>, building a <Studio> app, and rendering to MP4/WebM with @smoove/renderer, plus fast-fix gotchas for blank players, SSR, and server-side fonts/assets.
